categories.main_business_segments: Jiaxing ZMAX Optech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the precision optical lens industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of various optical lenses. Its main business segments include smart surveillance and sensing, intelligent detection and recognition, video communication and interaction, and high-definition shooting and display. The company also engages in technology development services related to optical lenses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced optical design, precision manufacturing, and modern information technology, integrating geometric optics, chromatics, thermodynamics, precision mechanics, and electronics. Key technologies include multi-element linkage zoom optical system design, wide-spectrum achromatic imaging, glass-plastic hybrid optical system design, high-precision optical component assembly and testing, and AI-enhanced optical systems. Production mainly involves lens assembly and adjustment with a flexible manufacturing approach, combining in-house production with outsourced processing and OEM procurement, including capabilities in plastic aspheric lens molding and coating.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves leading customers across multiple industries, including security surveillance, industrial inspection, video communication, consumer electronics, medical detection, unmanned aerial vehicles (drones), smart home, and automotive sectors. Major customers include Dahua Technology, Hikvision, and Panasonic. The products cater to markets requiring high-performance optical lenses for applications such as ultra-high-definition surveillance, industrial machine vision, video conferencing, and 8K ultra-high-definition imaging.
categories.geographic_coverage: Jiaxing ZMAX Optech operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales, complemented by overseas operations through subsidiaries in Taiwan and Japan. The company’s overseas revenue accounts for approximately 14.33% of total revenue, with key international markets served via its subsidiaries in Japan and Taiwan. The headquarters and main manufacturing facilities are located in Jiaxing, Zhejiang Province, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the optical lens supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of precision optical lenses. It also engages in upstream activities by producing some core optical components such as plastic aspheric lenses and lens barrels, enhancing supply chain stability and product development capabilities. Downstream, it sells finished optical lens products and provides customized technical development services to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment, dedicating over 10% of revenue to research and development, focusing on high-resolution, large-aperture, optical image stabilization, and long-focus zoom lenses. It pursues innovation in multi-element linkage zoom systems, glass-plastic hybrid lenses, AI recognition optical systems, and 8K ultra-high-definition imaging. Strategic initiatives include expanding product lines in smart surveillance, intelligent detection, video communication, and high-definition display, as well as developing new markets such as smart driving, smart home, and AR/VR. The company also actively participates in industry and national standards development and fosters talent acquisition and retention.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of optical lens products and related components to downstream customers, including large-scale contracts and VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory) arrangements. Additionally, the company earns income from technology development services, where customized optical design and prototype development are provided, sometimes leading to subsequent product sales. The sales model is predominantly direct sales, with a minor portion through trade channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiaxing ZMAX Optech positions itself as a leading domestic precision optical lens provider with a strong foothold in high-difficulty segments such as ultra-large zoom ratio lenses, ultra-long focal length, and high-performance zoom lenses. It competes with established international players like Zeiss, Canon, and Nikon, while leveraging its technological strengths and localized production to accelerate domestic substitution. The company holds competitive advantages in smart surveillance and sensing, intelligent detection, and 8K ultra-high-definition imaging, supported by its international R&D network and comprehensive product portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 454.7 million, representing a 20.01% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 53.43 million, up 47.06% from the previous year. The company maintains a healthy financial position with total assets exceeding RMB 1.05 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 860.6 million. R&D investment accounted for 10.69% of revenue, reflecting a strong growth trajectory supported by continuous innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-quality, precision optical lenses with advanced features such as ultra-high definition, ultra-long focal length, large zoom ratios, optical image stabilization, and AI-enhanced recognition capabilities. Its value proposition includes rapid customization, deep integration with customer product development cycles, and a comprehensive product range that balances imaging quality, size, weight, and manufacturability. The integration of glass-plastic hybrid lenses and in-house production of core components enhances supply chain reliability and product innovation, enabling the company to meet diverse and evolving customer demands across multiple high-growth application fields.
